% Issue: 106
% Title: The `margin` option has no effect on the second caption of `\bicaption`
% Date:  Oct 22, 2020 2:31pm GMT+0200
% URL:   https://gitlab.com/axelsommerfeldt/caption/issues/106

% I want to set margins for both captions generated by the command \bicaption. But it seems that the margin option affects only the first caption but not the second one.
% 
% Is this behavior correct?
% 
% The minimum working example is shown below.

\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[b6paper,landscape]{geometry}
\usepackage{lipsum}
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage{bicaption}
\captionsetup[bi]{singlelinecheck = false}

\begin{document}

\lipsum[1][1-3]
\begin{figure}[htbp]
  \begin{center}
    \includegraphics[height=2cm]{example-image-a}% from the `mwe' package
  \end{center}
  \bicaption{chinese caption}{english caption}
  \label{fig:example:a}
\end{figure}
\lipsum[1][1-3]

\clearpage
\lipsum[1][1-3]
\begin{figure}[htbp]
  \captionsetup[bi]{%
    margin = 21bp,
  }
  \begin{center}
    \includegraphics[height=2cm]{example-image-a}% from the `mwe' package
  \end{center}
  \bicaption{chinese caption}{english caption}
  \label{fig:example:b}
\end{figure}
\lipsum[1][1-3]

\end{document}
